name: OpenDefault
tagline: Help opening URLs with default App
blurb: Have you ever annoyed by some Apps which always open URLs in web browser, ignoring the fact that you have installed the dedicated app for that website?
description:
Have you ever annoyed by some Apps which always open URLs in web browser, ignoring the fact that you have installed the dedicated app for that website?

This is a little App which you can share any URL to and open it with the default App automatically, saving you a few clicks.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
